title: Classification of organic compounds
notes: **Fact.** IUPAC: identify parent chain (longest), number from end nearer the functional group / first substituent; suffix by priority (−ol, −al, −one, −oic acid…).
**Fact.** Carbocation/carbanion stability: 3° > 2° > 1° > methyl; resonance stabilises; inductive effect transmits through sigma bonds.
**Fact.** Functional group priority (high → low) governs the suffix; others become prefixes with locants.
